articles.title: Optimism-funded team's deciding vote shifts $49 million in OP tokens away from users
articles.snippet: The approved plan reallocates 546.9 million OP from user airdrops to a Foundation-controlled Strategic Ecosystem Fund.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Where DeFi yield really comes from (and why it broke this spring)
articles.snippet: In this week's Crypto Long & Short, Solstice Finance's David Plisek argues that most of the money lost in DeFi this spring wasn't taken by hackers but by yield strategies that quietly stopped working. Looking at April's $13 billion drawdown, he shows that a headline yield number reveals almost nothing about whether it will hold under stress, laying out four questions an allocator should ask before committing capital.

articles.title: Bitcoin Hits Highest Price Since June as $3 Billion in Shorts Liquidated
articles.snippet: Bitcoin punched above $72,000 Thursday, extending a two-day squeeze that's wiped out the most short positions on record and mounted the first real challenge to a bearish chart that's held since November.
